verdict.rationale: Vercel AI Gateway supports issuing distinct API keys per team/project and setting spend budgets per API key or team member (docs-16, docs-40), which gives some least-privilege control over how much an agent's credential can spend. However, there is no documented mechanism to scope a key to specific models, providers, or actions (e.g., restrict an agent key to read-only or a single model), which is the core of 'scoped/least-privilege' credentials for an agent persona. Missing for 10: explicit permission/scope restrictions per key (model/provider allowlists, role-based access), and independent confirmation that budget caps actually enforce hard cutoffs (community evidence [vercel-ai-gateway-comm-1] raises questions about BYOK behavior when balance hits zero, though that's about billing not scoping).
